About this project

A Community Service Project focused on learning about horticulture, understanding local cultivation challenges and sharing sustainable home-gardening practices.

Project introduction

Horticulture begins with healthy plants and informed communities.

Horticulture includes the cultivation and management of fruits, vegetables, flowers, ornamental plants and other useful crops. This project connects field observations with community awareness.

Project objectives

🥬

Nutrition

Encourage fresh fruits and vegetables through home gardening.

🌳

Environment

Promote greenery, biodiversity and responsible resource use.

♻️

Organic practices

Introduce composting, mulching and suitable plant care.

🤝

Awareness

Share practical gardening knowledge with community members.

Topics covered in the report

  • Home gardening and urban agriculture
  • Soil cultivation and plant propagation
  • Mango ripening and post-harvest concerns
  • Nursery plants and crop selection
  • Pests, diseases and water availability
  • Composting, mulching and sustainable gardening
Field learning

Activities documented in the CSP report

The following summaries are based on the weekly activity logs available in the uploaded document.

01

Introduction and community observation

Initial village survey, field visits and introduction to horticulture and its importance.

02

Horticulture and soil preparation

Learning about horticultural plants, soil preparation and cultivation practices.

03

Water and plant management

Study of water management, pest control and post-harvest handling challenges.

04

Farmer challenges

Observations relating to cultivation, quality, protected cultivation and farmer concerns.

05

Plant propagation and cultivation

Information gathering about root propagation, mango storage, silicon application and plant care.

06

Nursery visit and home gardening

Nursery observations, community discussions, composting, mulching and sustainable gardening awareness.

Documentation note: The supplied PDF contains detailed activity logs for Weeks 1–6. Weeks 7–8 are not included in the activity-log pages reviewed, so they have not been invented here.

Learning outcomes

What the project highlights

The outcomes and recommendations below follow the report's horticulture and community-awareness sections.

🌿 Sustainable gardening

Encourage composting, mulching, appropriate watering and plant selection suited to local conditions.

💧 Water conservation

Promote efficient irrigation, moisture retention and responsible water use.

🌾 Soil and plant health

Support soil fertility, regular plant observation and responsible pest management.

🤝 Community participation

Use awareness discussions and practical demonstrations to encourage local involvement.
